name: Australian Capital Territory

gate.mechanism: Most food businesses must register with the Health Protection Service before opening. Registration terms of 1, 2 or 3 years are available. A Food Safety Supervisor is required, with some non-profit exemptions. Premises are inspected before registration is granted.
gate.fee_notes: Low risk 1 year A$163; medium A$239.50; high A$321.55 (HPS Food Business New Registration form). Multi-year options available.

channels.render_reason: 7 of 8 not_published, table suppressed per spec 7.12
channels.notes: Food Act 2001 definition of food business covers commercial, charitable, community and single-occasion activity.

labelling.basis: Australia New Zealand Food Standards Code, Standard 1.2.1
required_elements: Supplier name and street address in Australia or New Zealand
Warning and advisory statements, and allergen declaration
labelling.allergen_rule: Allergen declaration required as a Code label element

training.fss_trigger: FSS required for most registered food businesses; some non-profit activities are exempt. Confirm exemption eligibility with HPS.

premises.inspection_frequency_basis: Premises inspected before registration is granted.

food_safety_management.standard_322a_trigger: Applies to Category 1 and Category 2 food service, catering and retail businesses handling unpackaged, potentially hazardous ready-to-eat food.

unique.quirk_paragraph: DRAFT: The ACT is a single-territory registration system through Health Protection Service and Access Canberra, with published low/medium/high risk fees and pre-registration inspection. Escalation needed for human polish of the single-occasion and charitable definition quirk.
unique.common_mistake: Assuming a one-off community stall sits outside the Food Act because it is not a shop or restaurant.
unique.what_does_not_apply: Some non-profit activities may be exempt from the Food Safety Supervisor requirement. Confirm with HPS before relying on that exemption.

information_gain: Single territory gate: HPS registration before opening, with Access Canberra portal
Published low-risk 1-year fee A$163 (medium A$239.50, high A$321.55)
Food Act 2001 covers commercial, charitable, community and single-occasion food businesses
Primary production carve-out exists; premises inspected before registration granted
